name: 抽象音效包
author: Yuuka
description:
需要DTMAPI 0.7.5以上。
改变部分操作的音效：
开纸箱-曼波
割草和采收--歪比巴卜
挖矿-我的刀盾
砍树-哈基米
鱼钩入水-咕咕嘎嘎
部分用相同音源的位置如作物、植被、挤奶和取毛设备、厕所、其他石头和树桩也会一起换声。

localized_description.tchinese:
需要DTMAPI 0.7.5以上。
改變部分操作的音效：
開紙箱-曼波
割草和採收--歪比巴卜
挖礦-我的刀盾
砍樹-哈基米
魚鉤入水-咕咕嘎嘎

localized_description.english:
Requires DTMAPI 0.7.5 or later.
Changes the sounds for these actions:
Opening cardboard boxes - Manbo
Cutting grass and harvesting - Waibi Babu
Mining - What the Dog Doin'
Chopping trees - Hachimi
Fishing hooks hitting the water - Gugu Gaga
Objects that use the same sounds, such as crops, plants, milking and shearing machines, toilets, other rocks and tree stumps, will change too.
